title: Identification of Flavonoid-based Hypoxia-inducible Factor-2 Alpha Inhibitors for the Treatment of Breast Cancer- In silico and In vitro Evidence.
authors: Shahinaz; Baba, Mursaleen; Gor, Ravi; Ramamurthy, Chandrasudan; Mohideen, Habeeb Shaik; Ramalingam, Satish; Vijayakumar, Thangavel Mahalingam
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选靶向HIF-2α的黄酮类抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究关联甚微。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer (BC) is a common malignancy that poses a serious threat to women's health. The hypoxic tumor microenvironment in BC promotes drug resistance, making hypoxia-targeted therapies crucial. Targeting hypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs), particularly HIF-2alpha, has emerged as a promising approach to inhibit tumor growth and improve response to chemotherapy and radiotherapy. However, further research is required to fully understand the role of HIF-2alpha to develop more effective treatments for BC. AIMS: The aim of this study is to identify phytochemicals that target HIF-2alpha and evaluate their effects on the MCF-7 breast cancer cell line under hypoxic conditions. METHODS: Molecular docking identified phytochemicals targeting HIF-2alpha, with high-affinity compounds undergoing stability evaluation via GROMACS molecular dynamics simulations. ADMET and toxicity assessments were performed using SwissADME and ProTox-3.0. In vitro assays on hypoxic MCF-7 cells examined cell viability and gene expression. The expression of HIF-2alpha-regulated genes (VEGFA, CCND1, GLUT1) was analyzed by using qRT-PCR. RESULTS: Molecular docking revealed that naringin (-8.2 Kcal/mol) and morin (-7.1 Kcal/mol) showed better binding affinity than the standard drug, belzutifan (-7.7 Kcal/mol). Dynamic simulations, including RMSD, RMSF, Hbond interactions, Rg, SASA, and PE, confirmed their strong binding potential. Morin, in particular, demonstrated more H-bond interactions and met Lipinski's Rule of Five, making it a promising candidate for in vitro studies. It reduced cell viability with an IC50 of 118 muM and significantly downregulated HIF-2alpha-associated genes. CONCLUSION: Morin demonstrated promising anti-cancer activity under hypoxic conditions by inhibiting HIF-2alpha in the hypoxia signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌（BC）是一种常见恶性肿瘤，严重威胁女性健康。BC中的缺氧肿瘤微环境促进耐药性，使得靶向缺氧的治疗策略至关重要。靶向缺氧诱导因子（HIFs），特别是HIF-2α，已成为抑制肿瘤生长并改善化疗和放疗反应的有前景方法。然而，仍需进一步研究以全面了解HIF-2α的作用，从而开发更有效的BC治疗方法。目的：本研究旨在识别靶向HIF-2α的植物化学物质，并评估其在缺氧条件下对MCF-7乳腺癌细胞系的影响。方法：分子对接识别靶向HIF-2α的植物化学物质，高亲和力化合物通过GROMACS分子动力学模拟进行稳定性评估。ADMET和毒性评估使用SwissADME和ProTox-3.0进行。体外实验在缺氧MCF-7细胞上检测细胞活力和基因表达。通过qRT-PCR分析HIF-2α调控基因（VEGFA、CCND1、GLUT1）的表达。结果：分子对接显示，柚皮苷（-8.2 Kcal/mol）和桑色素（-7.1 Kcal/mol）比标准药物belzutifan（-7.7 Kcal/mol）具有更好的结合亲和力。动态模拟，包括RMSD、RMSF、氢键相互作用、Rg、SASA和PE，确认了其强结合潜力。特别是桑色素，表现出更多的氢键相互作用并满足Lipinski五规则，使其成为体外研究的有前景候选物。它降低了细胞活力，IC50为118 μM，并显著下调了HIF-2α相关基因。结论：桑色素通过抑制缺氧信号通路中的HIF-2α，在缺氧条件下表现出有前景的抗癌活性。
